title: Bat holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left wing -->
  <polygon points='36,38 12,28 5,40 18,42 10,52 25,50 22,62 38,56' fill='#7B3FA0' stroke='#B06AD9' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Right wing -->
  <polygon points='64,38 88,28 95,40 82,42 90,52 75,50 78,62 62,56' fill='#7B3FA0' stroke='#B06AD9' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Wing inner membranes -->
  <polygon points='36,42 20,38 24,46 34,48' fill='#9B59C6'/>
  <polygon points='64,42 80,38 76,46 66,48' fill='#9B59C6'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='16' ry='18' fill='#8E44AD'/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='10' ry='11' fill='#B06AD9'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='15' fill='#8E44AD'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <polygon points='38,28 32,10 44,22' fill='#8E44AD' stroke='#B06AD9' stroke-width='1' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='62,28 68,10 56,22' fill='#8E44AD' stroke='#B06AD9' stroke-width='1' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Inner ears -->
  <polygon points='39,26 35,15 43,23' fill='#D291F0'/>
  <polygon points='61,26 65,15 57,23' fill='#D291F0'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='37' r='4' fill='#F5D0FF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='37' r='4' fill='#F5D0FF'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='37' r='2' fill='#3A1250'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='37' r='2' fill='#3A1250'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='36' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='36' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#D291F0'/>
  <!-- Fangs -->
  <polygon points='46,47 47,50 48,47' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <polygon points='52,47 53,50 54,47' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Left arm holding heart -->
  <path d='M36,54 Q30,62 38,66' fill='none' stroke='#8E44AD' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm holding heart -->
  <path d='M64,54 Q70,62 62,66' fill='none' stroke='#8E44AD' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d='M50,72 C50,72 40,64 40,72 C40,78 50,84 50,84 C50,84 60,78 60,72 C60,64 50,72 50,72 Z' fill='#FF4D6D' stroke='#FF8FA3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='72' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FFB3C1' transform='rotate(-30 46 72)'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='79' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#8E44AD'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='79' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#8E44AD'/>
</svg>
